title: "Member 2 Cassey Xing"
---

Your exploratory data analysis of the team datasets go here.
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

social_media <- read_csv("../appx/social_media_sleep_stress_productivity_11000.csv")
```

```{r}
head(social_media)
dim(social_media)
names(social_media)
```

```{r}
## 1: What is the distribution of Social Media Usage.
ggplot(social_media, aes(x = social_media_hours)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Daily Social Media Usage",
    x = "Social Media Usage (Hours)",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
—   The whole distribution of daily social media usage is maily concentrated from 0-7 hours. Only few of the individuals report more than 7 hours.

```{r}
## 2: What is the Relationship Between Sleep Duration and Stress Levels?
ggplot(social_media, aes(x = stress_level, y = sleep_hours)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "blue") +
  labs(
    title = "Sleep Duration by Stress Level",
    x = "Stress Level",
    y = "Sleep Duration (Hours)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
-  The different sleep duration related to similar stress level. Thus, there no specific relationship between the stress level and sleep duration.
